question: tell about the docs
answer:
This synthesis combines two distinct documents: one focused on AI-driven MQTT security vulnerability detection and another detailing Parth Katiyar's professional background. The MQTT project explores leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance IoT security in smart factories by detecting threats like denial-of-service (DoS) attacks and unauthorized access through machine learning and deep learning techniques. Key components include data preprocessing, model training, and performance evaluation using metrics such as detection accuracy and false positive rates. The project utilizes Python, Scapy, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and MQTT libraries, with milestones spanning six months. References highlight existing research on AI and blockchain approaches for MQTT security.

Parth Katiyar's resume outlines his academic and professional journey as a Computer Science and Engineering student at Thapar Institute, with internships at DRDO, Samsung R&D, and Sentinal Innovations. His experience includes developing AI systems, such as an expert recommendation engine and a document query engine using LLMs and RAG. Technical skills span programming languages, frameworks, and cloud technologies, supported by achievements in hackathons and leadership roles. Both documents emphasize technical expertise, innovation, and practical application of AI and machine learning in distinct contexts—security systems and professional development.

chunks.title: MQTT Security Vulnerability Detection using AI.ppt
chunks.content:
Title: MQTT Security Vulnerability Detection using AI
Problem Statement:
Can AI models detect MQTT security vulnerabilities by analyzing network traffic and message patterns, enhancing IoT security?
Description:
This project explores using machine learning to identify potential security threats in MQTT communication by analyzing network traffic patterns and message content, improving overall IoT security.
Challenge Use Case:
Detecting denial-of-service attacks and unauthorized access attempts in an MQTT-based smart factory.
Deliverables:
An AI-powered security vulnerability detection system for MQTT, a threat intelligence report, and performance evaluation metrics.
KPIs:
• Detection accuracy
• False positive rate
• Detection latency
• Number of identified vulnerabilities
Prerequisites:
• Proficiency in Python
• Understanding of MQTT protocol
• Knowledge of machine learning and deep learning
• Familiarity with network security principles
• Experience with data analysis and visualization
